verdict_reason: Works as intended, but selects the IDM discovery URL by a raw config key instead of the provider abstraction production uses, duplicating the provider-to-key rule.

todos.issue: The helper picks which discovery URL to serve by a raw config key ('discoveryUrlKey', exported 'idmOidcDiscoveryUrlKey = idm.oidcDiscoveryUrl', lines 10-16), while the production code this PR adds picks it by provider object: 'providerSetting(provider, oidcDiscoveryUrl)' over 'defraIdProvider' / 'idmProvider' (src/auth/identity-providers.js:4-24, get-oidc-config.js:11). Two vocabularies and two homes for one rule (where a provider's discovery URL lives); the IDM key is also spelt out again as a literal in verify-token.test.js:39,59, and the private 'oidcDiscoveryUrlKey' (line 10) no longer says which of the two discovery URLs it is.
todos.fix: Must: the test helper selects the provider the same way production does, and the provider-to-config-key rule lives only in identity-providers.js; no test or helper spells out 'idm.oidcDiscoveryUrl' or 'defraId.oidcDiscoveryUrl' as its own constant. One way: give discoveryUrlRequest/serveOidcDiscovery a '{ provider = defraIdProvider }' option and read the URL with providerSetting(provider, 'oidcDiscoveryUrl'); drop idmOidcDiscoveryUrlKey and pass idmProvider from idm-sign-in.test.js; if a key string is still needed for config.set/restore, export it once from identity-providers.js (e.g. a providerSettingKey(provider, setting)).

todos.issue: src/server/app/docs/testing.md:143-153 documents this file's exports as 'serveOidcDiscovery()' and 'discoveryUrlRequest({ persist, ...scopeOptions })', 'the nock interceptor at the configured discovery URL'; this PR adds a second discovery URL and a discoveryUrlKey option, and does not export idmOidcDiscoveryUrlKey in that list, so the doc no longer says which URL is served or how to serve the IDM one.
todos.fix: Must: testing.md describes the helper's current signature, including how a test serves the IDM provider's discovery document. One way: update the serve-oidc-discovery.js paragraph alongside the fix for the provider option.
